title: sbar configuration
description: Schema version 1. Item IDs must be unique across all sections and groups.

windowLevel.description: Floating keeps the bar above ordinary windows and below system notifications. Higher levels can cover notifications.

shadow.description: Draw a native window shadow, or a soft edge shadow for square bars spanning the display width.

text.description: Label template. Supports {{value}}, provider fields, {{#field}} / {{^field}} sections, and equality conditions such as {{#status=connected}} / {{^status=connected}}, closed by {{/status}}. Workspace providers also support {{#workspaces}}...{{/workspaces}} lists with per-entry styling. Empty text hides the label. VPN supports {{#services}} and Bluetooth supports {{#devices}}, with {{#separator}} between entries.

symbolPosition.description: Side of the text for symbols and application icons. Each provider segment keeps its order and places its symbol on this side. Null uses the default.

format.description: Unicode date/time pattern such as yyyy-MM-dd or HH:mm:ss. A nonempty format overrides dateStyle and timeStyle.

priority.description: Higher-priority items remain visible longer during overflow.

dateStyle.description: Localized datetime date style. Defaults to none; ignored when format is nonempty.

timeStyle.description: Localized datetime time style. Defaults to short; ignored when format is nonempty.

hoverTint.description: Text and symbol colour while an interactive item is hovered. Inherits from theme.itemStyle and otherwise keeps the normal tint.

hoverBackground.description: Replacement background while an interactive item is hovered. Inherits from theme.itemStyle and otherwise adds a subtle highlight over the normal background.

minWidth.description: Minimum item width in points, including the symbol, label, and padding. Longer content can grow. Ignored when width is set.

width.description: Fixed item width in points, including the symbol, label, and padding. Takes precedence over minWidth. Long labels truncate.

alignment.description: Content alignment within the item width. Inherits from theme.itemStyle and defaults to center.

cpu.description: warningThreshold must be below highThreshold, including default values.

path.description: Existing file or directory on the desired volume; defaults to the home directory.

disk.description: Critical free-space threshold must be below warning, including defaults.

hideWhenNotPlaying.description: Hide unless the selected source is playing, including while waiting for playback or when playback is unavailable.

pollInterval.description: Seconds between Mail queries. Enabled Mail items share the shortest interval.
